<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/vacations-request">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_VacationsRequest" name="Vacations Request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" name="Vacation request submitted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Register</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterRequest" name="Register vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Register</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Register_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveRequest" name="Receive request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Register_Receive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive_Evaluate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateRequest" name="Approve or reject request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive_Evaluate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Evaluate_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RequestDecision" name="Request decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Evaluate_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Decision_Rejected</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Decision_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest" name="Return rejected request to employee">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Decision_Rejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Return_Review</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons" name="Review rejection reasons">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Return_Review</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Review_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Rejection reviewed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Review_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateHRNotification" name="Generate notification to Human Resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Decision_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notification_Procedures</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteHRProcedures" name="Complete management procedures">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notification_Procedures</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Procedures_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProceduresCompleted" name="Management procedures completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Procedures_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Register" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" targetRef="Task_RegisterRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_Receive" sourceRef="Task_RegisterRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Evaluate" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRequest" targetRef="Task_EvaluateRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Evaluate_Decision" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateRequest" targetRef="Gateway_RequestDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_Rejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestDecision" targetRef="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">request is rejected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestDecision" targetRef="Task_GenerateHRNotification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">request is approved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_Review" sourceRef="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest" targetRef="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_End" sourceRef="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notification_Procedures" sourceRef="Task_GenerateHRNotification" targetRef="Task_CompleteHRProcedures"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Procedures_End" sourceRef="Task_CompleteHRProcedures" targetRef="EndEvent_ProceduresCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that an item is received by a specific role after a preceding activity: Model the receipt as a distinct activity assigned to the receiving role, preserving its stated sequence; do not use a generic receipt activity that omits the recipient.
rules.situation: the description states that an item is received by a specific role after a preceding activity

rules.instruction: When the description states a specific activity or process-ending outcome: Label the corresponding BPMN activity or end event with a concise phrase that preserves the stated action or outcome; do not substitute a related action or add an unsupported one.
rules.situation: the description states an activity or outcome and a label is being chosen for its corresponding BPMN element

rules.instruction: When the description presents mutually exclusive alternatives or says an activity may or may not occur, and the paths later continue in common: Model the choice with an exclusive gateway, and reconnect the alternative paths with an exclusive merge before their shared continuation.
rules.situation: the description presents mutually exclusive outcomes with separate handling steps that lead to a shared completion

rules.instruction: When the description distinguishes an initial submission or initiation from a subsequent registration of the item before another activity: Model the submission and the subsequent registration as separate activities, preserving their stated order and dependency.
rules.situation: the description distinguishes an initial submission or initiation from a subsequent registration of the item before another activity

rules.instruction: When the description states an activity, its object, scope, or recipient: Label the corresponding BPMN element so that it preserves the described action, object, scope, and direction; do not replace them with a related action or add unsupported details.
rules.situation: the description states an activity together with its action, object, scope, recipient, or direction
